_readme: CANONICAL Kanen Coffee repair pricing — single source of truth. Confirmed by Sam 2026-07-31, grounded in 12 months of QuickBooks invoices. When prices change, update THIS file first, then sweep help.kanencoffee.com pages AND kanencoffee.com Shopify pages (repairs, repairs-<brand>, faq, from-youtube, oakland/sf pages) — visible text AND FAQ JSON-LD schema together.

deposits.policy: Non-refundable. Applied toward the final repair bill. Separate from diagnostic charges.

most_repairs.basis: QB completed-repair invoices 2025-08..2026-07, n=554, medians rounded down to nearest $50

parts_policy: Only publish part prices for products actually sold in the Shopify store, at the store price (e.g. Ulka EX5 $44, Breville BES870XL solenoid $95, Gaggia Classic solenoid $74.95, Silvia Tune-Up Kit $19.99). Never publish installed-part or third-party part prices.
